items.finding: The temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary.
items.how_it_applies: This indicates that temperature compensation or controlled sample temperature should be considered when designing the in-line monitoring setup.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited study discusses general biopharmaceutical downstream processing in a laboratory or review context rather than an in-line clear aqueous sucrose manufacturing line.
